mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_rating (user_id, item_id, item_type, rating, rated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{itemType}, #{rating}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rating = VALUES(rating), rated_at = NOW()
MERGE INTO user_rating (user_id, item_id, item_type, rating, rated_at) KEY (user_id, item_id, item_type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{itemType}, #{rating}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_rating WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND item_id = #{itemId} AND item_type = #{itemType}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, item_id AS itemId, item_type AS itemType, rating, rated_at AS ratedAt FROM user_rating WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND item_id = #{itemId} AND item_type = #{itemType}
SELECT CAST(item_id AS SIGNED) AS itemId, AVG(rating) AS avgRating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_rating WHERE item_type = #{itemType} AND item_id IN #{id} GROUP BY item_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_rating WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND item_type = #{itemType}
